output_text: Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first. NEVER modify any file under `coder/` — it is read-only reference material. NEVER commit changes to `coder/`. Do not add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files. Do not create separate `tests/` directories — Use `#[cfg(test)]` in-file. Use `thiserror` for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`. Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect()`. `unwrap_used = "deny"` — Use `?` or explicit error handling, never `.unwrap()`. `expect_used = "deny"` — Same; no `.expect()` either. `panic = "deny"` — No `panic!()`. `todo = "deny"` — No `todo!()` macros. `dbg_macro = "deny"` — No `dbg!()` left in code. `unsafe_code = "forbid"` — No `unsafe` blocks at
